## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`

Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md, skills/objectstack-ui/evals/README.md, skills/objectstack-ui/evals/record-page.json, skills/objectstack-ui/rules/navigation.md, skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md, skills/objectstack-ui/rules/record-page.md + scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs, packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts, ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/recordPageColumns.ts, ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/recordTabRow.ts, ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordTabRow.tsx, ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/relatedArrangement.ts, ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/buildDefaultPageSchema.ts, ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedCardMenu.tsx, ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedCardStack.tsx, ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/useRelatedCounts.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/deriveRelatedLists.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewRecordNavigation.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/recordOpenPreference.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/workspacePreference.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/recordFormNavigation.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/urlParams.ts, ui/scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs, packages/skills/package.json. The rest of the diff (content/docs/ui/pages.mdx, content/docs/ui/views.mdx, .changeset/27059-skills-record-page-rules.md) is the lane seat's ACCEPT at TIER_DEFAULT.

Check-runs on this head at review time: every completed run is `success` or `skipped` (Lint & Repo Gates lanes, TypeScript Type Check lanes, Build Core, Build Docs, Lint UI, Type Check UI, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Test UI 1–16, Test Core 2–8, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Check Changeset, Check PR Size, PR-body guards, Dogfood Regression Gate); `Test Core (1/8)` was still `in_progress` on the last poll — not a pass until its conclusion reads `success`.

### ① Derived judgments

Every public-surface change the diff implies — the skill is published (`@objectstack/skills`, the `skills/**` tree synced into the tarball) and loaded whole into customer agent context. Each read against `main` at merge-base `8c3f9d93` / `origin/main` `ea74ebf9`:

1. `rules/record-page.md` §1 — the object's declarations produce the page: `nameField`, `highlightFields`, `stageField` (option `kind: 'open' | 'won' | 'lost'`, `false` suppresses), `fieldGroups` + `Field.group`, `relatedLists`, `editMode` (`'modal' | 'page'`). **Right** — `object.zod.ts` 3375 / 3416 / 3483 (+ the `kind` refinement at 2338–2430) / 3226 / 3459 / 3501. The `detail` block and `relatedLayout` named as removed (ADR-0085): **right** — `detail` is a tombstone at `object.zod.ts` 1606.
2. §1 column tiers — two columns from 760 px (details | 动态 and the related panels), three field columns from 1120 px, one column below; a tab row (概览, 动态, one tab per panel with its count) enlarging a panel at `?related=object.field`. **Right** — `recordPageColumns.ts` `RECORD_PAGE_TWO_COLUMN_MIN_WIDTH = 1024 − 256 − 8 = 760`, `RECORD_PAGE_WIDE_MIN_WIDTH = 1440 − 256 − 64 = 1120`, `recordPageTierFor`; `RecordTabRow.tsx` (概览 first, `timeline` 动态, `object.field` ids, `CountChip`); `urlParams.ts` `RECORD_RELATED_ENLARGE_PARAM = 'related'`.
3. §2 relationship flags — `relatedList: 'primary'` body table after the first field section (default for `master_detail` + `inlineEdit`), `true`/absent a right-column panel, `false` off; `relatedListTitle` / `relatedListColumns` (child field names); `relatedListFilter` AND-composed with the parent condition, count honours it; rows in the child's default list-view `sort` (`isDefault`, else the first declared); `relatedLists` orders tables and panels alike. **Right** — `field.zod.ts` 1927 / 1929 / 1952 / 1993; `deriveRelatedLists.ts` (`isBodyTableRelationship`, `inheritedListViewSort`, `filter` carried, `resolveRelatedListOrder(…, objectDef.relatedLists)` — the authored order is read, `RecordDetailView.tsx` 3632); `buildDefaultPageSchema.ts` 225–240 (body table right after the first field section); `useRelatedCounts.ts` 50–85 (the count target carries the list's `filter`). Note: the `relatedArrangement.ts` module header still says the authored `relatedLists` order "is not read here or anywhere on this page yet" — a stale Console comment, contradicted by `deriveRelatedLists.ts` which the page reads; the rule teaches what the code does, not that comment.
4. §3 slotted page — six slots `header`, `actions`, `alerts`, `highlights`, `details`, `discussion`, each whole; `slots.tabs` / `slots.related` / `slots.relatedLists` refused by name; `isDefault: true`. **Right** — `page.zod.ts` 2109–2130 (`tabs: retiredKey(PAGE_SLOTS_TABS_RETIRED)`, `guidance: { related, relatedLists }`), 1689–1710 (`isDefault` on a record page).
5. §4 `kind: 'full'` as the escape hatch with `regions`. **Right** — `page.zod.ts` 1204–1230 / 1768–1812.
6. §5 open mode — drawer by default, `navigation: { mode: 'page' }` by declaration, `new_window` / `none`, `modal` / `split` / `popover` removed in 18.3.0 (ADR-0087 D2) and refused with a fix, field count never decides, a phone always pages. **Right** — `view.zod.ts` 2826–2903 (`NavigationModeSchema`, `.default('drawer')`, `NAVIGATION_MODE_RETIRED`); `objectViewRecordNavigation.ts` 96–131 (`phone` → `deriveRecordSurface(…, { viewport: 'mobile' })`; no authored navigation → `{ mode: 'drawer' }` "whatever the object's field count").
7. §6 the reader's choices — Display menu **Open records** (split default / drawer / page; drawer-mode objects only), ⊟ (`⌘⇧,`, per object), panel order and hidden set (⠿, ⌥↑ / ⌥↓, per user × object), pane width and ⤢; on `navigation` only the `size` bucket nudges the drawer's starting width (`width` / `drawerWidth` deprecated). **Right** — `recordOpenPreference.ts` (`DEFAULT_RECORD_OPEN_PREFERENCE = 'split'`, read only for a drawer-mode record), `RecordDetailView.tsx` 118 (`⌘⇧,`), `workspacePreference.ts` 143–160 (`record.columns.related` per object, `record.related.arrangement` per object), `RelatedCardMenu.tsx` 62–108, `objectViewRecordNavigation.ts` `recordPaneSize` (`auto` → `md`, an authored bucket stands), `view.zod.ts` 2924–2933.
8. The `os:check` example — `Field.masterDetail('lead', { relatedList: 'primary', relatedListFilter: { status: { $ne: 'done' } } })` on a `sharingModel: 'controlled_by_parent'` object. **Right** — `masterDetail(reference, config: FieldInput = {})` spreads `config`, `FieldInput` (a partial `Field` without `type`) carries `relatedList*`; `relatedListFilter` is `FilterConditionSchema` (Query-DSL); the only `controlled_by_parent` parse refinement (`object.zod.ts` 2690–2706) judges `sharing.controlledByParent.ownerMayEdit`, which the example does not set, and the builder forces `required: true` on the master FK (4250).
9. `SKILL.md` — the two related-list paragraphs (Details / Related / Timeline tab strip, shared Related tab, `relatedLayout` keys) become a two-line pointer; one Detailed Rules link; the blueprint's "Record pages" row says the page is synthesized and `*.page.ts` is for a slotted slot or `kind: 'full'`. **Right** — nothing the removed sentences taught survives on `main` (`recordPageColumns.ts` header: "There is no tabbed tier … the 动态 stream is a panel, never a column"); the replacement claims are items 1–7.
10. `rules/pages.md` — the `tabs`-slot sentence becomes a one-line pointer. **Right** — same tombstone as item 4; the file's table at 131 (`full` / `slotted` kinds) still agrees.
11. `rules/navigation.md` — the Surface bullet now points at §5–6 and the Overlay-width bullet moved whole into §6. **Right** for the record surface; **wrong** for the retained create / edit half — see ④ should-fix 1.
12. `evals/record-page.json` + README bullet — two evals grading the lead-page task as `relatedList: 'primary'` + `relatedLists` (never `definePage` / `slots.tabs` / `kind: 'full'`) and the full-page ask as `navigation: { mode: 'page' }` + the Display menu (never `mode: 'split'` / `'modal'` / `'popover'` / `definePage`). **Right** — shape matches the sibling fixtures (`skill_name`, `files: []`, `must_contain` / `must_not_contain`); every `must_contain` token is a whole token in the bundle's own markdown (`record-page.md`: `relatedList: 'primary'`, `relatedLists`, `navigation: { mode: 'page' }`, `Display menu's` — the apostrophe is a non-identifier boundary under `wholeTokenPattern`), so `check-skill-eval-tokens` has a taught token for each; the eval population is measured, not ratcheted, so no CEILINGS row is owed for it.
13. `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` — three rows LOWERED to the measurement and one new row. **Right on the numbers**, re-derived from the PR head's bytes under the script's own convention: `record-page.md` 3981 B → ceil(3981/4) = **996**; `navigation.md` 8787 B → **2197**; `pages.md` 22673 B → **5669**; `SKILL.md` 14194 B less its 20-byte stamp line (`  version: "18.2.0"`) = 14174 → **3544**. Line budget re-derived: 307+204+464+311+162+428 = 1876 → 287+204+464+311+157+427+65 = 1915, **+39 ≤ 40**. See ③ item 4 on the row's authority.

No schema, key, default, runtime path or generated reference moves: `packages/spec` untouched; `gen:skill-docs` reads SKILL.md frontmatter only (`build-skill-docs.ts`), and the frontmatter is unchanged, so no generated artifact is owed.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/27059-skills-record-page-rules.md`: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. The diff publishes teaching text in the `skills/**` tree that `packages/skills` ships (`sync-catalog.mjs`) and nothing from any other released package; nothing an author can write is added, narrowed or re-meant — `none` takes `patch`. The PR body carries the same two line-initial declarations. **Matches** (AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist step 3). The changeset body names no tracker number in prose, no model identifier; its "Before / Now" sentences agree with the diff.

Clause-②: no

### ③ Boundary flags

1. **The card names `skills/objectstack-ui/references/pages.md`; the path does not exist.** Answered: `references/` on `main` holds only the generator-owned `_index.md` and `react-blocks.md` (the ratchet's population 2); the page rules the card means are `rules/pages.md`, edited here. Correct substitution, no scope widening.
2. **Ruling 2 (a per-user timeline-column switch) is superseded on `main` by #28116.** Answered: the card's own Target 1 says "what is the reader's (drawer | split, timeline / related toggles, drawer width) and therefore not written in metadata"; on `main` the 动态 stream is the right column's first panel (`recordPageColumns.ts`: "the 动态 stream is a panel, never a column"; `workspacePreference.ts`: "the timeline column's switch, `record.columns.timeline`, retired with the column") and the reader's switch is ⊟ plus the panel arrangement. §6 teaches exactly that and still satisfies the ruling's substance — the toggle is the reader's, never metadata. The skill must teach what ships; no re-decision of the ruling occurs here.
3. **Two follow-ups left out of scope** — `skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md` (the `relatedList` tri-state bullets) and the `relatedList` `.describe()` in `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts` 1927 still say "the shared Related tab" / "inside the Details tab on the tabbed page". Confirmed stale on `main` (read at 1927: "a side card in the record's related column (the shared "Related" tab on the tabbed page) … inside the Details tab on the tabbed page"). Escalated correctly: the first is a sibling skill with its own ratchet row and the card's budget is this package's; the second is spec text whose edit regenerates the references (a `packages/spec` change outside the card's file surface). Both are filed in the dev report's `out_of_scope_findings` with a carrier; not a FAIL here — but the `SKILL.md` pointer no longer sends the reader to objectstack-data → Relationships, so the stale sibling is no longer in the new file's reading path.
4. **A new CEILINGS row the script prints as ⛔ MAINTAINER-ONLY.** The script's own text (header, "The ratchet discipline": "a ruling of record that orders text into a file still authorises its own measured delta … the deletion and the quote are checked by the seat's contract-review record, never here"; and the no-ceiling refusal: "adding a CEILINGS row … is the maintainer ruling this ratchet implements — not a step an author takes while landing the file"). Judged: (a) the text is ordered into the file by the card's PM-set, binding budget (Target 3, +40 lines) and the seat's dispatch ruling that the record page gets its own rules file, both of record on card #27059; (b) the diff shows genuine same-file deletion paying it down (SKILL.md −307, navigation.md −76, pages.md −20 measured tokens; the tab-strip sentences the retirements made false, not a re-wrap); (c) the row is pinned AT the measurement with zero headroom and its provenance written beside it. This record is the seat's check of (b) and (c). What this record cannot do is stand in for the maintainer's hand on a new row: the PR is Tier H (`skills/**`), so the landing act is the maintainer's approval through `os-zhuang` in any case, and that approval is the authority the row needs — the dev escalated it there rather than claiming it. Escalated, correctly. Should-fix on the row's comment arithmetic, see ④.
5. **Not raised by the dev, answered here:** the `navigation.md` section intro ("all three are derived at runtime from how heavy the record is + the client viewport") is unchanged context above the edited bullet and is now contradicted by §5 ("Field count never decides") for the surface — see ④ should-fix 1.
6. The four files PR #28488 holds open are untouched (verified on the file list). `check:role-word`: the new file carries no "role" (the card's own word "roles" became "declarations"). No tracker number in any skill sentence; ADR ids and the spec version only.

### ④ Design judgment

Judged on the `hits` files only, each against the card's eval prompt and the spec it teaches on `main`, trying to break each rule: does an agent following it write metadata the spec accepts and the Console draws as the rule says?

**`rules/record-page.md`** — holds. Walked both eval prompts through the six steps: (eval 1) "tasks first on the lead page" → §2 → `relatedList: 'primary'` on `task.lead` (+ `relatedListFilter`, + `relatedLists: ['task', …]`), no page file — the spec accepts all three keys (`field.zod.ts` 1927 / 1993, `object.zod.ts` 3459) and the Console draws the body table after the first field section in the parent's declared order (`buildDefaultPageSchema.ts`, `deriveRelatedLists.ts`); the full-page reflex is closed by §3 (no `tabs` slot) and §4 (full only when 1–3 cannot). (eval 2) "contracts open as a full page … beside the list too" → §5 `navigation: { mode: 'page' }` on the list view (accepted, `view.zod.ts` 2853) and §6 the Display menu, not metadata — `split` would be refused at parse with the prescription that says the same. Attempts to break it: a `kind: 'slotted'` page with `slots.related` → refused by name (§3 says so); `size: 'auto'` → `md` 720 px, not field-count-derived (§6 says only the bucket nudges — consistent with `recordPaneSize`); a phone → page whatever the view says (§5). The one residual inaccuracy is below the rule's resolution: `relatedListFilter` is AND-composed and the count honours it — true — but §2 does not say the filter is "declared-vs-absent" (an empty object forwards nothing, `isDeclaredFilter`); no agent writes `{}` on purpose. Not a finding.

**`SKILL.md`** — holds. The pointer and the blueprint row agree with the spec and the Console (① items 9, 1–7). The removed sentences (Details / Related / Timeline tabs, `record:related_list` blocks "or inline-editable `line_items`" for filtered splits) were the false ones; the one survivor an agent might still follow — "assign the object a custom record Page … for filtered splits" — now reads as §4 `kind: 'full'`, which is the correct answer on `main`.

**`rules/pages.md`** — holds. One-line pointer; the file's kind table and component catalogue still name `full` / `slotted` and `record:related_list` exactly as `page.zod.ts` does.

**`rules/navigation.md`** — holds for the record surface. **Should-fix 1:** the re-authored Surface bullet keeps "Create / edit opens in a **modal** for a field-heavy record, otherwise a drawer." On `main` create / edit is the global `ModalForm` with `formType: 'modal'` (`AppContent.tsx` 1567–1600; `resolveRecordFormModalLayout` only sizes the dialog, `full` on a phone) or the full-page route when the object declares `editMode: 'page'` (`recordFormNavigation.ts` `resolveRecordFormTarget`); there is no drawer and no field-count branch. The sentence contradicts `record-page.md` §1, which teaches `editMode` correctly in the same bundle, and the section's intro line ("derived at runtime from how heavy the record is") is likewise stale for the surface. Replacement that fits the ratchet at zero headroom by deleting the false clause: "Create / edit opens in a **modal**, or the full-page route when the object declares `editMode: 'page'`" and drop "how heavy the record is + " from the intro. It produces no metadata an agent would write, so should-fix, not must-fix.

**`evals/record-page.json`** — holds. Each eval has one correct answer under the rules file; `must_not_contain` closes the reflexes the card names (`definePage`, `slots.tabs`, `kind: 'full'`, the three retired modes). One observation, not a finding: eval 2's `must_contain` token `Display menu` grades prose, not metadata — acceptable because the card's point is that nothing is authored for it, and the bundle teaches the phrase.

**`evals/README.md`** — holds; the bullet matches the fixture.

**Cited gate, `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`** (read as one change with the rule it prices) — the four numbers reproduce (① item 13). **Should-fix 2:** the new row's comment says "PAID DOWN FIRST by the 403 tokens the three rows above gave up (… SKILL.md 307 + navigation.md 76 + pages.md 23)" — those three addends sum to 406 (ceiling deltas: 5692 → 5669 is 23), while 403 uses the measured 20 (`pages.md` measured 5689 on `main`, 3 under its old ceiling); write "pages.md 20 (its ceiling 23)" or "406" so the arithmetic in the provenance line is self-consistent. Comment-only; the pinned constants are right.

No must-fix. Two should-fixes, both one-line, neither producing wrong metadata.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-e9o3bz`
Reviewed-by: `session_01L9qibw2uhdSeHYfnZdAf4V`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `2bc940e37476cb8a64219c69f24ab6fca06524b3`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md, skills/objectstack-ui/evals/README.md, skills/objectstack-ui/evals/record-page.json, skills/objectstack-ui/rules/navigation.md, skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md, skills/objectstack-ui/rules/record-page.md + scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs, packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts, ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/recordPageColumns.ts, ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/recordTabRow.ts, ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordTabRow.tsx, ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/relatedArrangement.ts, ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/buildDefaultPageSchema.ts, ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedCardMenu.tsx, ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedCardStack.tsx, ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/useRelatedCounts.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/deriveRelatedLists.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewRecordNavigation.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/recordOpenPreference.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/workspacePreference.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/recordFormNavigation.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/urlParams.ts, ui/scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs, packages/skills/package.json. The rest of the diff (content/docs/ui/pages.mdx, content/docs/ui/views.mdx, .changeset/27059-skills-record-page-rules.md) is the lane seat's ACCEPT at TIER_DEFAULT.

This is a delta record over record 6552150282 on `198adea5a9116d1ced74a8853160045fe7ea504b`, which stands for everything the one new commit does not touch. The new head is exactly one commit on top of that head (`2bc940e3 docs(skills): create / edit is a modal or the editMode page route, never by field count`); its diff touches two files, `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/navigation.md` (+2 / −2) and `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` (+9 / −7), and nothing else — the whole-PR file list against `main` is still the same ten paths, and the other four priced files are byte-identical to the prior head (`record-page.md` 3981 B, `pages.md` 22673 B, `SKILL.md` 14174 priced bytes, each at its pinned ceiling).

Check-runs on this head at review time: the completed runs are all `success` (Governed Surface Queue Guard, Check PR Size, PR-body guards, Check Documentation Links, Dogfood Regression Gate, filter) or `skipped` (the opt-in and schedule-gated jobs); the gate-carrying jobs — every Lint & Repo Gates lane, every TypeScript Type Check lane, Build Core, Build Docs, Check Changeset, Spec property liveness, Live E2E UI, Build UI Deps, Plan Test Core shards — were `in_progress` on the last poll, and the Test Core / Test UI / Lint UI / Type Check UI / Build & E2E UI shards had not yet been scheduled. Green on this head means those conclusions read `success`; none did yet.

### ① Derived judgments

Delta only. (1) `rules/navigation.md` — the section intro now says the surface, overlay width and column count are "derived at runtime from the client viewport" (the false "how heavy the record is + " clause deleted), and the Surface bullet now says "Create / edit opens in a **modal**, or the full-page route when the object declares `editMode: 'page'`." **Right** — `recordFormNavigation.ts` `resolveRecordFormTarget` answers `{ kind: 'modal' }` unless `objectDef.editMode === 'page'`, in which case it answers the `/new` or `/record/:id/edit` route; `AppContent.tsx` 1567–1600 opens the global `ModalForm` with `formType: 'modal'`; `resolveRecordFormModalLayout` only sizes that dialog (`full` on a phone). No drawer, no field-count branch: the sentence now agrees with `record-page.md` §1 (`editMode` `'modal' | 'page'`), which record 6552150282 ① item 1 judged right. (2) `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` — `navigation.md` row 2197 → 2196 with its comment reworded; the new `record-page.md` row's provenance comment now reads "404 tokens … SKILL.md 307 + navigation.md 77 + pages.md 20, its ceiling 23" and "the package nets +592 tokens". **Right, re-derived from the new head's bytes**: `navigation.md` 8784 B → ceil(8784 / 4) = **2196** (the bullet shrank by 3 bytes); 2273 − 2196 = **77**; 307 + 77 + 20 = **404**; 996 − 404 = **592**. The row is pinned at the measurement, zero headroom, the ratchet's ordinary direction. Line budget unchanged: `navigation.md` is still 157 lines, so the package stays at 1915 (+39 ≤ 40). Everything else in ① of record 6552150282 stands unchanged.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged: `.changeset/27059-skills-record-page-rules.md` is untouched by the delta (`'@objectstack/skills': patch`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`); the delta publishes one corrected teaching sentence and a lowered ratchet constant — `none` still takes `patch`. Record 6552150282 ② stands.

Clause-②: no

### ③ Boundary flags

No new flag raised by the delta. The MAINTAINER-ONLY row for `record-page.md` is unchanged in constant and authority (record 6552150282 ③ item 4 stands: ordered by the card's PM-set budget and the seat's own-rules-file ruling, paid down by same-file deletion now summed correctly, and landed only by the maintainer's Tier H approval). The lowered `navigation.md` row needs no ruling — lowering is always legitimate. Both should-fixes of record 6552150282 are closed by this commit: should-fix 1 (the false create / edit sentence and the stale intro clause) and should-fix 2 (the 403 / 406 arithmetic). Nothing else in ③ moves.

### ④ Design judgment

Delta on the one `hits` file the commit touches. **`rules/navigation.md`** — holds. The corrected Surface bullet now teaches the one key that decides how create / edit opens (`editMode: 'page'`, accepted at `object.zod.ts` 3501) and no longer implies a field-count-derived drawer the Console does not draw; an agent following it writes either nothing (modal, the default) or `editMode: 'page'`, which the Console honours. The reworded intro still keeps the rule's point (presentation is not metadata) without the false mechanism. The other five `hits` files are byte-identical to the head record 6552150282 judged; its ④ stands for them. Cited gate: the two changed comment lines and the one constant reproduce from the tree (① above). No must-fix, no remaining should-fix.

domain:ui#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibw2uhdSeHYfnZdAf4V
